name: Animation & Motion Design Prompts
body: # FLUX 3 animation and design prompts Four original prompts for handcrafted stop-motion, anime staging, VFX titles, and multilingual kinetic typography. ## 1. Tea on the Paper Moon — handcrafted stop-motion **Use case:** miniature storytelling **Format:** 16:9, 16 seconds, visible 12 fps cadence ```text SET: A tiny paper moon in an indigo cosmos built from layered cardstock, cotton nebulae, stitched stars, and visible support-wire charm. CHARACTERS: Character A wears a navy embroidered cap. Character B wears a soft gray rabbit-eared hood. Preserve button eyes, felt seams, scale, costumes, and seats. 00:00-00:06 — Locked miniature wide shot. Character A pours translucent amber tea. Animate in deliberate stop-motion increments; cotton steam unfolds frame by frame. 00:06-00:11 — Slow practical push-in. A folded-paper comet crosses behind them from right to left. Character B notices first and taps Character A's sleeve twice. 00:11-00:16 — Both look up. The comet's thread tail illuminates the tea, then exits. Character A raises the cup in a silent toast. Hold the last handmade pose for eight frames. AUDIO: Felt rustle, miniature ceramic clicks, soft pour, wooden mechanism ticks, one delicate music-box phrase timed to the comet. No speech. AVOID: smooth CGI motion, glossy plastic, changing facial design, extra limbs, moving table geometry, human hands, captions, franchise resemblance, watermark. ``` ## 2. Bento Physics Club — expressive original anime scene **Use case:** anime, character acting, educational comedy **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds, Japanese dialogue ```text STYLE: Original hand-drawn anime with clean linework, restrained cel shading, painted classroom background, and readable acting. Do not imitate a named studio, series, artist, or existing character. CHARACTERS: Emi, short auburn bob, round green glasses, cream cardigan, red pencil behind left ear. Haru, tall, wavy black hair, pale blue overshirt, analog stopwatch. Preserve design, uniform details, desk positions, and height difference. 00:00-00:06 — Wide after-school science room. Emi places three identical cherry tomatoes on a miniature ramp made from a lunch-box lid. Haru holds the stopwatch ready. Warm sunlight comes through windows on frame left. 00:06-00:12 — Side close-up. The tomatoes roll; one veers into a rice ball, which rotates but does not deform. Emi says exactly in Japanese: "摩擦にも、お昼ごはんが必要だね。" Haru suppresses a laugh. 00:12-00:18 — Overhead. Haru writes one result in a notebook while Emi rescues the tomato with chopsticks. Exact handwritten heading only: "実験 07". End on their quiet high-five above the lunch box. AUDIO: Rolling tomatoes, tiny impact, pencil, cicadas outside, natural Japanese dialogue, one brief pizzicato phrase after the joke. AVOID: chibi transformation, speed lines, exaggerated mouth flaps, food duplication, extra students, fan-service framing, extra text, watermark. ``` ## 3. Tidal Memory — liquid VFX title reveal **Use case:** title design, VFX, brand-neutral opener **Format:** 2.39:1, 12 seconds, black background ```text GOAL: Create one elegant title reveal using physically coherent liquid behavior. BACKGROUND: Pure black studio void with a thin horizontal reflective surface. No horizon line except where reflections reveal it. 00:00-00:04 — Three silver droplets fall at different intervals and strike the surface. Each impact produces a circular ripple whose speed and amplitude decay naturally. Macro camera, extremely slow dolly forward. 00:04-00:08 — The three ripple rings intersect. At each intersection, liquid rises into thin strokes; the strokes connect gradually, not instantaneously. 00:08-00:12 — Strokes settle into exact centered title: "TIDAL MEMORY". Letters remain made of stable reflective liquid, readable for three full seconds. A final low ripple passes through the reflection only; the title itself does not warp. AUDIO: Three distinct droplet impacts, low glassy resonances corresponding to droplet size, subsonic swell during assembly, clean silence for the final second. LIGHT: One cool strip light above and one dim warm rim behind; consistent reflections. AVOID: extra words, misspelling, chrome solid letters before assembly, explosive splash, smoke, particles, lens flare, logos, watermark. ``` ## 4. Make It Move — multilingual kinetic type **Use case:** motion graphics, typography accuracy, language separation **Format:** 4:5, 15 seconds, four exact text strings ```text STYLE: Contemporary Swiss-inspired motion design with tactile paper, translucent glass ribbons, precise grid lines, charcoal background, electric coral, cobalt blue, and warm white. Crisp editorial spacing. TEXT — render each phrase exactly once, with no translation or extra characters: 1. "MAKE IT MOVE" 2. "让灵感流动" 3. "創造を動かす" 4. "DA VIDA A TUS IDEAS" 00:00-00:05 — The English title assembles from stacked white paper layers in the upper two-thirds. Camera remains orthographic; letterforms never rotate out of readability. 00:05-00:10 — Coral and blue glass ribbons sweep vertically, revealing Chinese and Japanese lines below the title. Each line stays isolated on its own baseline for at least two seconds. 00:10-00:15 — Spanish line slides into the lower grid. All four languages align into a final stable poster. Hold for three seconds with zero character motion. AUDIO: Paper shuffle, soft glass swish, four muted percussive clicks, one for each completed line. No voice-over or song. AVOID: misspellings, duplicated lines, random glyphs, vertical Japanese layout, tiny text, perspective distortion, extra copy, logo, watermark. ```
description_en: Four prompts for handcrafted stop-motion, original anime staging, VFX titles, and multilingual kinetic typography — each specifying frame cadence and material texture.
description_zh: 四条动画类提示词：手作定格动画、原创动画分镜演出、VFX 片头、多语种动态排版——每条都写明帧率节奏与材质质感。
long_en: The stop-motion prompt asks for a visible 12 fps cadence, felt seams, button eyes, and support-wire charm, and holds the final handmade pose for eight frames — details that push the model away from smooth CGI. Character blocks lock costume and facial design across the clip, audio blocks name specific Foley, and AVOID lists rule out glossy plastic, extra limbs, franchise resemblance, and watermarks.
long_zh: 定格动画那条要求呈现可见的 12 fps 顿挫感、毛毡缝线、纽扣眼睛以及吊线的手作痕迹，最后一个手工姿势保持八帧——这些细节的作用是把模型从光滑 CGI 的默认风格上拉开。角色段落锁定全片的服装与五官设计，音频段落点名具体拟音，AVOID 清单排除光亮塑料感、多余肢体、与既有 IP 的相似性以及水印。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. One prompt specifies Japanese dialogue and another multilingual typography — generated text and speech in any language need native review before release. The AVOID lists ask the model to steer clear of franchise resemblance, but that is a request, not a guarantee; check output for IP resemblance yourself. Written for FLUX 3, whose availability is staged; the source repo also hosts an affiliate-program page for a commercial API reseller.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。其中一条指定日语对白，另一条涉及多语种排版——任何语言的生成文字与语音，发布前都需要母语者复核。AVOID 清单要求模型避开与既有 IP 的相似性，但那只是请求而非保证，成片仍需自行检查版权风险。以 FLUX 3 撰写，该模型分阶段开放；来源仓库另挂有某商业 API 转售商的联盟推广页。
